units.source_text: 这秋宵并非为了情人相逢而苦短，但不久也就向晓了。

en.t: This autumn night was not made short by lovers meeting, yet before long it too was nearing dawn.

units.source_text: 薰君看了这各有所长的双美中一人的姿色，自然而然地感到不能餍足。

en.t: Kaoru looked upon the beauty of one of the two lovely women, each gifted in her own way, and naturally felt that he could not be satisfied.

units.source_text: 最后对她说道：“我俩相爱吧。

en.t: At last he said to her, "Let the two of us love each other.

units.source_text: 你不可模仿你那可恨的姐姐的薄情！”

en.t: You must not imitate the heartlessness of that hateful elder sister of yours!"

units.source_text: 和她约了后会之期，然后辞去。

en.t: He arranged a time to meet her again, then took his leave.

units.source_text: 他仿佛做了一梦，自己也觉得奇怪。

en.t: It seemed to him as if he had dreamed a dream, and even he found it strange.

units.source_text: 然而那个薄情人的态度究竟如何，他总想看个清楚，便按住了热情，

en.t: Yet he still wanted to see clearly what that heartless person's attitude truly was, and so he held back his passion,

units.source_text: 走到一向住惯的那个房间里去，躺下身子。

en.t: went to the room where he had always been accustomed to staying, and lay down.
